children: Strive announced $369.2 million expected proceeds from warrant exercises and a purchase of 2,822 bitcoin at about $83,266 each.
273,493,909 traditional warrants exercised for 13,674,703 Class A shares, generating expected gross proceeds of $369.2M.
As of Oct 13, 2026 close, no traditional warrants from the Company's PIPE transaction remain outstanding.
Strive purchased 2,822 bitcoin between Oct 12–13, 2026 at an average price of ~$83,266 per BTC, inclusive of fees and expenses.
